Dave Grohl Announces He's Fathered A Child Outside Of His Marriage
The Foo Fighters frontman has been married to wife Jordyn Blum for 21 years.
By
Kelby Vera
Senior Reporter
Sep 10, 2024, 07:17 PM EDT
LEAVE A COMMENT

Dave Grohl
says he has fathered a child with a woman who is not his wife.
The Foo Fighters frontman shared the
news on Instagram
on Tuesday, writing, “I’ve recently become the father of a new baby daughter, born outside of my marriage. I plan to be a loving and supportive parent to her.”
“I love my wife and my children, and I am doing everything I can to regain their trust and earn their forgiveness,” the message went on. “We’re grateful for your consideration toward all the children involved, as we move forward together.”
Advertisement
Grohl’s statement did not include any additional details about his new daughter or her mother.
Representatives for Grohl declined to comment further to HuffPost.
Jordyn Blum and Dave Grohl attend London's Wimbledon Tennis Championships on July 2, 2024. Grohl announced he fathered a child with someone other than his wife on Tuesday.
Karwai Tang via Getty Images
The former drummer for Nirvana is already the father of three: daughters Violet Maye, 18, Harper Willow, 15, and Ophelia Saint, 10.
He has been married to Jordyn Blum, their mother, since 2003. The couple’s last public appearance was at Wimbledon in London in July.
Advertisement
Prior to marrying Blum, the “Everlong” rocker was wed to photographer Jennifer Leigh Youngblood from 1994 to 1997.
While Grohl rarely speaks about his family, he talked about being a father in a now-archived 2009 Q&A with Time magazine.

an article by People
